newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 27.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on February 27:
WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan issued his strongest warning to stock market investors that their expectations may be too rosy.
WASHINGTON - Stock and bond prices dropped sharply after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan again questioned whether the market's rapid rise was justified.
WASHINGTON - The Arch Deluxe didn't bring new customers into its stores so now McDonald's Corp. appears poised to try something old -- price cutting.
WASHINGTON - Computer networking giant 3Com Corp. said it would spend $6.6 bln to buy U.S. Robotics Corp.
WASHINGTON - Chile makes a bid to join NAFTA with President Eduardo Frei warning that the United States could lose out on booming Latin markets.
